title: The 1980s Pop Music Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Rewritten for the Bronze starter set on 20 August 2026 — three rounds now, mixed round types. Read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which 1984 charity single kept Wham!'s "Last Christmas" off UK No.1?
options: I Wish It Could Be Christmas Everyday
questions.answerNote: Band Aid's charity single blocked Wham!'s 'Last Christmas' from the top spot in December 1984.

questions.prompt: Which 1982 Michael Jackson album became the best-selling album of all time?
questions.answerNote: Thriller was released in November 1982 and still dominated UK charts through 1983.

questions.prompt: "Every Breath You Take" was a 1983 UK number one for which band?
questions.answerNote: It turned out to be The Police's final UK number one before they split up.

questions.prompt: Which duo topped the UK charts in early 1986 with "West End Girls"?
questions.answerNote: Neil Tennant and Chris Lowe had been a journalist and architecture student before forming the duo.

questions.prompt: Which Frankie Goes to Hollywood single was famously banned by BBC Radio 1 in 1984?
questions.answerNote: DJ Mike Read refused to play 'Relax' on air, which only boosted its sales.

questions.prompt: Culture Club's "Karma Chameleon" was the UK's best-selling single of which year?
questions.answerNote: It topped the UK charts for three weeks in autumn 1983.

questions.prompt: Which Norwegian band had a huge 1985 hit with "Take On Me"?
questions.answerNote: The song's pencil-sketch animated video won six MTV awards in 1986.

questions.prompt: Kylie Minogue's UK number one debut single in 1988 was called what?
questions.answerNote: It launched Kylie's pop career straight after her role in Neighbours.

questions.prompt: Rick Astley topped the UK charts in 1987 with which song?
options: She Wants to Dance with Me
questions.answerNote: The song became internet-famous decades later through 'Rickrolling'.

questions.prompt: Live Aid, featuring Queen's famous Wembley set, was held in which year?
questions.answerNote: Live Aid took place simultaneously at Wembley Stadium and Philadelphia's JFK Stadium.

rounds.title: Round Two — Pick Them All
rounds.blurb: More than one answer is right. Lock in every one of them.

questions.prompt: Which of these were UK number one singles in the 1980s?
questions.answerNote: Bohemian Rhapsody's UK number ones were 1975 and 1991. Livin' on a Prayer and Take On Me both stalled at number 2 and 4 in the UK.

questions.prompt: Which of these artists had a UK number one album in the 1980s?
questions.answerNote: Nirvana and Oasis are both 1990s acts.

questions.prompt: Which of these performed at Live Aid in July 1985?
questions.answerNote: Neither Nirvana nor Oasis had formed yet in 1985.

questions.prompt: Which of these are genuine 1980s Michael Jackson albums?
questions.answerNote: Dangerous (1991), HIStory (1995), Invincible (2001) and Michael (2010) all came later.

questions.prompt: Which of these films had an 1980s hit single written for it?
questions.answerNote: Ghostbusters (Ray Parker Jr), Flashdance... What a Feeling (Irene Cara), Footloose (Kenny Loggins), Take My Breath Away (Berlin, from Top Gun).

rounds.title: Round Three — First Letter
rounds.blurb: Just the first letter of the answer. Spelling does not count.

questions.prompt: Which 1985 Kate Bush song became a global streaming hit decades later after featuring in Stranger Things?
questions.answerNote: It reached UK number one for the first time in 2022, thirty-seven years after its original release.

questions.prompt: Which 1985 all-star charity single was written by Michael Jackson and Lionel Richie to raise money for famine relief?
questions.answerNote: The US answer to Band Aid's 'Do They Know It's Christmas?'.

questions.prompt: Which 1984 Prince album and film shares its title with a purple weather phenomenon?
questions.answerNote: Prince won an Oscar for Best Original Song Score for the film.

questions.prompt: Which British synth-pop band, without its leading article, had a 1982 hit with 'Don't You Want Me'?
questions.answerNote: 'Don't You Want Me' was the UK's Christmas number one in 1981.

questions.prompt: Which 1983 Bonnie Tyler song contains the lyric 'turn around, bright eyes'?
questions.answerNote: Written and produced by Jim Steinman.
